spec.query: SELECT "contract_error", "is_buy", "time_since_latest_block_pre_fill_us" / 1000 as "ntwrk block millis", "my_timestamp_minus_block_timestamp_us" / 1000 as "prtcl block millis", "dex", "pool", "alive" as "count", "lot_size_usd", "fill_size_usd", "expected_pnl_pre_fill" AS "exp pre-fill pnl", "expected_pnl_post_fill" AS "exp post-fill pnl", "expected_pnl_post_fill" - "expected_pnl_pre_fill" AS "slippage", "rt_pnl", "excess_pnl", "estimated_bribe_fee_usd", "actual_bribe_fee_usd", "edge_bps", "block_number_pre_fill" AS "pre fill block", "tx_block", "version", "gas_usage_pct", "estimated_l1_gas_fee_gwei" as "estimated l1 fee gwei", "actual_l1_gas_fee_gwei" as "actual l1 fee gwei", "defi_buy_price_pre_fill", "defi_sell_price_pre_fill", "defi_actual_fill_price", "estimated_base_fee_per_gas_gwei" as "estimated base fee gwei", "actual_base_fee_per_gas_gwei" as "actual base fee gwei", "priority_fee_per_gas_gwei" as "priority fee gwei", "buy_estimated_gas", "sell_estimated_gas", "actual_gas", "tx_hash"  FROM "default_defi_retention"."op_defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/) AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 30000

SELECT 
  mean("price_difference") 
FROM (
  SELECT 
    ("defi_sell_price_pre_fill_min" - "defi_sell_price_pre_fill_max") * 10000 / "defi_sell_price_pre_fill_min"  AS "price_difference" 
  FROM 
    "op_defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0" 
  WHERE 
    "stage" =~ /^$stage$/ 
    AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ 
    AND "network" =~ /^$network$/ 
    AND "dex" =~ /^$dex$/ 
    AND "pool" =~ /^$pool$/ 
    AND $timeFilter 
) 
GROUP BY 
  time(30m) 
fill(null)
